Legacy historical DWD FST filename prefix

fn_histDWD_data_str.Rd

Retained for compatibility with code that constructs year-only filenames such as weather_dat_1990.fst. New code should use dwd_fst_filename(), which includes the complete start date.

Usage

fn_histDWD_data_str

Format

A character scalar containing a filename prefix.

Deprecated

This prefix is retained only for locating legacy year-only FST files.
